**Status:** The fix is committed locally as a new commit on top of `f3d2ab1fd3b`. I have not pushed it, as you asked. The remote head is still `f3d2ab1fd3b`, so CI has not changed. The new local SHA is printed by `git rev-parse HEAD` after the commit. I can't run anything more, so I haven't filled it in here.

**Test results (API 35 emulator, playground app, `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`, no `versionCode` in `android {}` or the manifest):**
- Clean install: `adb uninstall`, then `adb install app-arm64-v8a-release.apk` returned `Success`. `dumpsys package` shows `versionCode=0`.
- Update over a versioned build: I installed a build with `versionCode=7`, then ran `adb install -r` with the same APK. It returned `Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE]`.

The current KDoc sentence ("builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which Android refuses to install") is wrong. @mboetger is right: the APK installs, and Android treats it as `versionCode` 0. It fails only when it replaces an install with a higher `versionCode`. Not suggesting the flag is still the right call, because the APKs it builds can't update existing installs and can't go to Play. So this is a doc fix only. The code is correct, so rule 25 needs no code change.
